detailed_descriptions.en: The third season of Being a DIK picks up where the previous season ended, answering big questions and asking new ones. With over 25000 images and 1500 animations, Season 3 is bigger than Seasons 1 and 2 combined! Choices matter The branching storyline will have you replay the season repeatedly to experience all the content. The story is meticulously tailored to your past Seasons 1 and 2 choices. In this game, choices truly matter. Continue your story, deepen your relationships, and experience more songs, mini-games, achievements, and girls in this highly anticipated DLC. Being a DIK - Season 3 is even bigger than previous seasons and includes "Interlude - Riding the Waves" and Episodes 9-12. Interlude - Riding the Waves What happened before you came to B&R? Delve deeper into your character's past by controlling Zoey and experiencing her side of the story. Episode 9 - Vixens When the DIKs are throwing a big Halloween party, you're left to deal with the problems that arise. As people come together to party, friendships and relationships are tested. Episode 10 - Calm Before the Snow Classes have reconvened, and the DIKs are dealing with the aftermath of the Halloween party. As Thanksgiving closes, a big plan is set into motion. Episode 11 - Paradigm Shift Winter has come. A fight breaks out and you're left wondering who you can trust. While some grow closer than before, others may never return to what they once were. Episode 12 - Smoke and Fire The year comes to an end, as does your first semester at B&R. The choices you have made, the divergent road you wander... Will you look at your journey the same after you have peered beneath the surface? Being a DIK: Season 4 will be the final season that concludes the story. It will be released and sold separately as DLC.

The third season of Being a DIK picks up where the previous season ended, answering big questions and asking new ones.

With over 25000 images and 1500 animations, Season 3 is bigger than Seasons 1 and 2 combined!

Choices matter

Continue your story, deepen your relationships, and experience more songs, mini-games, achievements, and girls in this highly anticipated DLC.

Being a DIK - Season 3 is even bigger than previous seasons and includes "Interlude - Riding the Waves" and Episodes 9-12.

Winter has come. A fight breaks out and you're left wondering who you can trust. While some grow closer than before, others may never return to what they once were.

Episode 12 - Smoke and Fire

The year comes to an end, as does your first semester at B&R. The choices you have made, the divergent road you wander... Will you look at your journey the same after you have peered beneath the surface?

Being a DIK: Season 4 will be the final season that concludes the story. It will be released and sold separately as DLC.
